thread:
samir: FYI — seeing ~40 logins in the last hour where the user gets 'Support' role via JIT even though tenant policy requires manager attribute to map to team roles. Spike started ~1766999000, right after yesterday's KMS rotation.

elaine: looking now. can you grab one SAML assertion (sanitized)? any okta errors in syslog?

samir: pasted sanitized assertion:
```
<AttributeStatement>
  <Attribute Name="uid"><AttributeValue>u12345</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <Attribute Name="roles"><AttributeValue>support</AttributeValue></Attribute>
  <!-- manager attribute missing -->
</AttributeStatement>
```
No SAML errors on client side. The mapping rules should have required `manager` or `team` to pick non-fallback role. not sure why fallback kicked in.

nina-idp: checking Okta events — I see assertions for these users marked with `encrypted="true"` for eduPerson attributes before rotation. After rotation the attribute decrypt step shows transient errors for some assertions (KMS decrypt 5xx). Could be intermittent decrypt failure falling back to role default.

ben: can you point to the RBAC refactor PR? did we change fallback semantics?

carla: PR #3782 changed JIT mapping precedence last week — it puts mapped roles from `roles[]` attr first, then falls back to tenant default. Intended to be safe but looks like it's too permissive for missing manager attr. https://github.com/redwood-inference/rbac/pull/3782

samir: makes sense. those SAML assertions include `roles: support` when manager missing (we populate a default in the SSO pipeline). If decrypt failed for manager, pipeline still injects support. Need to know if injection happens before or after KMS-decrypt.

nina-idp: pipeline order: decrypt -> normalize attrs -> inject defaults. Hm — log shows decrypt succeeded in most cases but ~8% have decrypt timeout. Might be race with async KMS. I'll open KMS logs.

devops-bot: deploy rbac-service@2026-03-12T03:12 completed by deploy-bot (sha: abc123)

elaine: For immediate mitigation can we stop injecting tenant-default role when manager is missing? toggle in config and roll back PR if needed.

samir: Agreed. rolling config toggle now to disable role injection for JIT. Will also revert mapping precedence if toggle insufficient.

elaine: toggle flipped at 1767001000. monitoring.

ben: Audit logs: I queried `audit.role_assignments` — lots of entries with actor `okta-jit` and reason `fallback_role_applied`. For GDPR/audit we should record decrypt errors as well. Right now decrypt errors are only in idp logs, not central audit.

carla: filed SEC-1234 to add decrypt_error audit events and a test for missing-manager onboarding. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-1234

nina-idp: KMS team confirmed a transient rotate-related latency spike at 2026-03-12T02:58 that caused ~7% decrypt timeouts. They patched and metrics look normal now.

devops-bot: rollback rbac-service@2026-03-12T03:40 performed (sha: def456)

samir: quick checks — post-toggle last 20 logins show proper role assignment (non-support) when manager present; previous spike absent. thanks.

ben: recommend follow-ups: (1) add audit event when fallback role applied (2) surface KMS decrypt error in central audit stream (3) add canary test covering attribute decrypt failure -> ensure no unauthorized elevation

elaine: assigning follow-ups to sec-eng and idp: SEC-1234 contains the action items. I'll add owners. :thumbsup:

samir: closing thread for now, will reopen if we see recurrence. thanks everyone.
